messages: emma: Pushed a docs PR for offline/onprem install notes that consolidates KMS/HSM quick snippets and adds an airgap packaging checklist. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 :wave: josh: Nice. Quick scan: we lost the old `#hsm-network` anchor after the rewrite, lots of external links still point to it. Can we add an alias anchor rather than changing all external links? lee: I vote for alias. Simple HTML anchor at the top: `` then keep the new `#sealedsite-hsm-network` id where the diagram lives. That preserves older docs links and avoids redirects. pat: Also spotted the PKCS#11 example doesn't show `--list-objects` output, which customers use to debug key visibility. Suggest adding a tiny block showing a label + object id. doc-bot: Lint check PR #912: broken_links=1, anchors_missing=1, codeblock_lang_missing=0, required_frontmatter=OK. Please address before merge. emma: I'll add the alias anchor and a TOC update. Pat, can you paste the minimal pkcs11 snippet you recommend? pat: Sure, here's a minimal example for docs: ``` # list slots pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --list-slots # list objects in token pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --list-objects --login --pin 1234 # sample output Object 0: label: my-signing-key id: 01 type: Private Key ``` josh: Please also add a short troubleshooting note about MTU/tunnel issues. We've had a customer whose HSM TCP keepalives broke when GRE encapsulation doubled headers; lowering MTU to 1500 fixed it. infra-eng: For airgap bundles: remember to include any vendor PKCS#11 libraries and the correct version of the kernel module. We should add a packager example showing where to place vendor files in the tarball and how to include checksums. emma: I'll add a short packager example and systemd unit for kms-proxy to the quickstart. Proposed unit: ``` [Unit] Description=redwood kms-proxy After=network.target [Service] ExecStart=/usr/bin/kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml Restart=on-failure LimitNOFILE=65536 [Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target ``` lee: LGTM. One more thing: update the appendix title to "Vendor HSM appendix" so the TOC is clearer. doc-bot will catch it if missing. doc-bot: Reminder: add anchor alias for backward compatibility, add TOC entry "Vendor HSM appendix", and include mtus/troubleshooting bullet. emma: Action items: pat -> confirm pkcs11 output (done), infra-eng -> review airgap bundle snippet and add DKMS note, josh -> sanity check anchor alias HTML, lee -> update TOC title. I'll open a quick follow-up PR for the anchor alias if needed. ETA tomorrow morning to merge? josh: I can ship the anchor alias PR now. infra-eng: I'll validate the bundle snippet and post a short note about DKMS and module compatibility. emma: Thanks everyone ":rocket:" — ping here when reviews are complete and I'll merge.
